memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Epilepsy and COPD stable on current therapy.
Patient reports no seizures in the past month, mild dyspnoea on exertion, uses salbutamol inhaler as needed. Examination: respiratory rate 18, SpO2 94% room air, wheeze absent, neurological exam normal. Spirometry: FEV1 1.8 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.5 L, FEV1/FVC 0.72; no prior test for comparison. Asthma Control Test score 18 (not well controlled). Inhaler technique checked: correct for tiotropium Respimat and budesonide-formoterol Dry Powder; inspiratory flow adequate. Smoking status: never. Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, tiotropium inhaler OD, salbutamol inhaler SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Epilepsy seizure-free, COPD mild exacerbation.
Patient reports no seizures, increased cough and wheeze over past 10 days, used salbutamol inhaler 4-5 times daily. SpO2 92% room air, respiratory rate 20, mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally. Spirometry: FEV1 1.6 L (48% predicted) down 0.2 L from last, FVC 2.4 L, FEV1/FVC 0.67. Asthma Control Test score 16 (not well controlled). Inhaler technique corrected: advised to hold breath 5 seconds after Dry Powder inhalation. Smoking status: never. Continue epilepsy meds; add short course oral prednisolone 40 mg daily for 5 days, continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, increase budesonide-formoterol to 2 puffs BD (maintain).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Epilepsy stable, COPD post-exacerbation recovery.
Patient reports seizure-free, cough resolved, wheeze only occasional with salbutamol use 1-2 times daily. SpO2 94% room air, respiratory rate 18, chest clear. Spirometry: FEV1 1.7 L (52% predicted) up 0.1 L from last, FVC 2.5 L, FEV1/FVC 0.68. Asthma Control Test score 20 (well controlled). Inhaler technique checked: correct for all devices. Smoking status: never. Continue epilepsy meds, tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, discontinue prednisolone.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Epilepsy and COPD well controlled.
Patient denies seizures, reports mild exertional dyspnoea only on stairs, uses salbutamol inhaler <2 times per week. SpO2 95% room air, respiratory rate 16, chest clear. Spirometry: FEV1 1.8 L (55% predicted) up 0.1 L from last, FVC 2.6 L, FEV1/FVC 0.69. Asthma Control Test score 22 (well controlled). Inhaler technique checked: correct; inspiratory flow adequate for Dry Powder. Smoking status: never. Continue current epilepsy and COPD regimen.
